about: Parksville is a city on the east coast of Vancouver Island, British Columbia, on the Strait of Georgia north of Nanaimo. Famous low-tide sandy beaches, a harbour village feel, and a gateway role toward Port Alberni and the Island Highway define a mid-Island seaside community. About 14,000 people live in Parksville.
seoSummary: East Vancouver Island seaside city north of Nanaimo—sandy beaches, harbour village, and Island Highway gateway.
